description: Works to a tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 66 1977: (T1) English oak - Remove to ground level and treat the stump to prevent any regrowth.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The Local Authority does not consider the submitted evidence sufficient to justify the proposed removal of a valuable, mature and prominent tree of significant amenity that makes a positive contribution to the amenity of the locality and wider Borough. Furthermore, insufficient consideration has been given to alternative management measures, remedial works, or other reasonable solutions that would enable the retention of the tree. In the absence of sufficient information to justify its loss, the proposed works would result in an unacceptable adverse impact on local amenity.
